about_the_game:
Hit and Stand Blackjack is a relaxed 2D card game where you play classic blackjack at your own pace.

No timers, no pressure — just sit back, play your hand, and enjoy the calm atmosphere.

The only sound in the game is a gentle background music track, designed to help you relax. Prefer silence? You can easily adjust or disable the music in the settings.

Features:

  • Classic solo blackjack

  • Over/Under side bet: Guess if your starting hand totals over or under 13 for bonus credits

  • Split pairs for more chances to win

  • Multiple difficulty levels — from casual to challenging

  • Five unlockable achievements

  • Relaxing background music only (no sound effects)

  • Customizable audio and language settings

Whether you're unwinding after a long day or looking for a chill card game, Hit and Stand Blackjack is your perfect match.
